decisions.reason: As a relatively small web-map add-on that was no longer observed after 2019, the hierarchical search plugin is likely to be retired as a standalone product and absorbed into project work or broader platform capabilities.
Despite its initial visibility, the mobile layer control component appears more likely to be folded into newer mobile solutions than maintained as a separate marketed product.
The GIS solution platform remains closely aligned with the firm's strategic direction and flagship positioning, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn.
Mobile field data capture fits well with enterprise geospatial workflows and customer needs, making continued support more likely than withdrawal.
The search extension is a useful but non-core modular feature and is increasingly likely to be discontinued as a separate offer in favor of the main platform and custom solution development.
